plugin.name: Anonymous NetEase Music
plugin.description: Play matching songs, search NetEase playlists, and curate and save personal playlists
plugin.short_description: Anonymously search and play an exact NetEase Music match
entry.play.name: Play a NetEase Music song
entry.play.description: Call only when the user explicitly asks to play a specific song on NetEase Music. Format query as “title artist” and preserve live, cover, or version qualifiers. Do not use for lyrics, song facts, general recommendations, playlists, pause, stop, skip, or next-track requests.
entry.play.param.query: Song search phrase, preferably “title artist”, with at most 100 characters
messages.no_results: No matching NetEase Music song was found. Try a more specific title or artist.
messages.unavailable: This song has no publicly available source for anonymous playback. It may require sign-in or a membership.
errors.missing_target: The current playback session could not be determined, so the request was cancelled.
errors.search_failed: NetEase Music search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.media_failed: The NetEase Music source could not be validated, so no playback was submitted.
errors.delivery_failed: The playback action could not be submitted, and playback did not start.
errors.message_delivery_failed: The result message could not be delivered.
playlist.title: NetEase playlist playback and collection
playlist.need_name: Which local playlist should hold this song?
playlist.no_track: The player has no confirmed NetEase track to save.
playlist.added: Added {song} by {artist} to {name}. Tracks in playlist: {count}.
playlist.already_saved: {song} by {artist} is already in {name}. Tracks in playlist: {count}.
playlist.need_queue: Play a playlist first and give it a name.
playlist.no_results: Too few matching tracks to start playback.
playlist.same_tail: The new selection repeats earlier tracks. Keeping the queue.
playlist.revised: Current song continues with {count} new tracks to follow.
playlist.paused: Four tracks were unavailable. Say “next track” to continue.
entry.playlist.description: Use curate for background music: choose 6–8 tracks from chat and music preferences, each as “title | artist”. Use search with a name to find a public NetEase playlist. revise replaces upcoming tracks without interrupting the current song. save_current appends the confirmed current song to a named local playlist, deduplicating IDs. Use save only to save the whole queue, replay for a saved playlist, list to list saved playlists, next to skip, and stop to end playback.
playlist.not_found: No saved local playlist named “{name}” was found. Please use its exact saved name.
playlist.replay_need_name: Which saved local playlist would you like to replay?
playlist.ambiguous: More than one saved playlist could match: {names}. Please choose the exact name to replay.
